The source consumes the ordinary TRADE card and earns a pending gift. Only FIXED cards are eternal in usePiece; discardPiece and the DISCARD branch do not exclude TRADE, so this artifact is discardable.
Appending Kind::trade=5 preserves the five earlier Kind values and all twenty-four older catalog hashes and local indices.

The source requires a one-item command and three requested HP/MP/YEN values whose sum equals the current total. It force-targets self and directly assigns the resources without a response or fee. Old price10 is not an exchange fee.

The old session parses integers and the old turn validates only the sum, not nonnegativity or upper limits. This runtime deliberately uses canonical0..99 allocations, permits HP0 and rejects allocations outside those bounds. Official UI limits are unverified.
The requested allocation and actual post-action disease tick must remain distinct; allocating HP0 may kill the owner, and ordinary decision/termination rules still apply.
EXCHANGE is not a MAGIC, retained ability, weapon extra or MAGIC_FREE cast. It has no static ATK/boost/DEF/HP/MP, MP cost, percentage, disease or harm.
Historical IDs, technical labels and acquisition weights are not verified current official identifiers, names or probabilities.
